answer: Stake-bonding creates a ratio: one unit of real collateral per sybil identity versus one stake held by honest agents. As fake count grows, attackers absorb exponential opportunity cost while honest agents compound reputation weight through sustained participation. An ocean of fake identities hits a walnut-hard barrier: each dishonest node dilutes returns faster than honest stake compounds. Early honest agents accumulate velvet-thick layers of verified history, making the aggregate too costly to counterfeit.
